name: Dashlane
description: Dashlane is a password manager and credential security platform that stores, shares, and monitors passwords while detecting phishing and compromised credentials.
best_for: Individuals and businesses that want a secure credential vault with proactive breach and phishing detection.
features: Encrypted vault for logins and credentials across devices
Secure sharing with granular admin controls and role-based permissions
Credential risk detection for weak and compromised passwords
AI-powered phishing detection before credentials are entered

alternatives.name: 1Password
alternatives.description: A password manager and secrets vault for individuals, families, and businesses.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a polished password manager with strong admin controls

alternatives.name: Bitwarden
alternatives.description: An open-source password manager for individuals and organizations.
alternatives.best_for: Users and teams wanting an open-source, self-hostable option

alternatives.name: NordPass
alternatives.description: A password manager with zero-knowledge encryption, breach scanning, and passkey support.
alternatives.best_for: Individuals and businesses wanting simple, secure password management
